strains.name: Grape OG Kush
strains.description: Kickflip Genetics attached an unusually long terpene list to this indica: linalool, myrcene, pinene, caryophyllene, terpinolene, bisabolol, and eucalyptol all appear on the profile, seven compounds spanning floral, piney, peppery, and even minty-cool territory. That's a broader terpene spread than most single-cultivar listings carry, and it suggests a more layered aromatic character than the average Kush cross, even without a specific flavor description to match it. THC testing lands between 18.9% and 22.9%, comfortably into the higher range for an indica and consistent with the OG Kush lineage the name references. No effects or medical uses have been documented for this cut, so the terpene chemistry and the potency numbers are what define Grape OG Kush on paper.
strains.shortDescription: Grape OG Kush is an indica from Kickflip Genetics with a seven-compound terpene profile and 18.9-22.9% THC.

strains.name: Grape OG Feminised - 6
strains.description: Diving into this indica strain from Seedsman, you'll enjoy a moderately potent 16.2% THC hit that brings euphoric and relaxed vibes, making it a favorite for shaking off anxiety, insomnia, pain, and stress with a blissful ease. Flavored by dominant terpenes caryophyllene, myrcene, and linalool, it boasts a delightful berry, grape, and sweet profile that tastes like a fresh fruit bowl, setting it apart with its fruity twist on classic indica traits. This strain's unique charm lies in how it combines uplifting euphoria with deep relaxation, perfect for a cozy evening in.
strains.shortDescription: Grape OG Feminised - 6 is a indica cannabis strain by Seedsman with up to 16.2% THC. Known for its relaxing body effects and sedating properties.

strains.name: Grape OG 2
strains.description: This indica cut comes from Purple Caper Seeds, carrying forward the resinous, heavy-limbed structure the OG family is known for. Lab sheets on this version show a hefty 20.8 to 23.4 percent THC ceiling, putting it solidly in the potent end of the indica spectrum for anyone shopping by numbers alone. Flowering runs nine to ten weeks, a touch longer than average, which rewards growers willing to let the buds pack on extra density before the chop. Beyond potency and timeline, Purple Caper hasn't published much on height, yield, or difficulty for this particular offering, so cultivators are largely working from the strain's reputation and their own trial runs. For anyone assembling an indica lineup and comfortable with a slower finish, the THC range here is the standout selling point, and it's worth tracking how this cut performs once more grow notes surface.
strains.shortDescription: Grape OG 2 is an indica from Purple Caper Seeds testing 20.8-23.4% THC, with a longer nine to ten week flowering window.
